title: Adult fractures: hands, feet, legs, hips and shoulders
description: Radiographs of adults from FracAtlas with one fracture each, outlined by the dataset's annotators (two expert radiologists and an orthopedist): one view per injury, no hardware. FracAtlas has no patient identifiers, so at most one image is taken from each block of 100 image numbers. Each image was checked by eye with the outline drawn. 8-bit JPEGs as distributed: no pixel spacing.

sources.name: FracAtlas: musculoskeletal radiographs with fracture annotations
sources.citation: Abedeen I, Rahman MA, Prottyasha FZ, Ahmed T, Chowdhury TM, Shatabda S. FracAtlas: A Dataset for Fracture Classification, Localization and Segmentation of Musculoskeletal Radiographs. Sci Data. 2023;10:521. doi:10.1038/s41597-023-02432-4. Data: figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.22363012.v7
sources.accessNote: FracAtlas.zip read member-by-member (HTTP Range, CRC-32 checked) from figshare; COCO_fracture_masks.json and dataset.csv from the same archive. No login.
